use_magic_device.name: Use Magic Device
use_magic_device.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Spellcraft or Decipher Script gives +2 each on Use Magic Device checks involving scrolls. You cannot Take 10 or Take 20 on Use Magic Device checks.

actions.name: Use a Wand
actions.description: Activate a wand or other spell trigger item as if its spell were on your class spell list.

actions.name: Use a Scroll
actions.description: Activate a spell completion scroll (DC 20 + caster level).
